items.caption: This seal-script-style redraw presents the received dictionary form of 新. It provides a visual comparison for the competing accounts of the graph, but does not resolve whether its structure reflects 斤 with 辛, sometimes accompanied by 木, or an expansion of 𣓀.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style 新, with a short top stroke, a dense middle structure and a long curved stroke descending at the right.
items.selection_reason: It makes the received dictionary form available for comparison with the competing analyses of 新; its modern redraw cannot establish which analysis is correct.

items.caption: This Western Zhou bronze-script-style redraw shows a form of 新 amid reported variation in early forms. It is relevant to discussions of the graph’s components, but does not establish a single sequence or settle the competing origin analyses.
items.alt: Black bronze-script-style 新, with a short top stroke, a broad complex structure on the left and a tall curved stroke on the right.
items.selection_reason: It offers a distinct script-style comparison connected by its description to a vessel inscription, while paleographic accounts report varied forms and competing interpretations.

limitations.text: These are modern redrawings, not artifact photographs or direct facsimiles. The bronze-style redraw is associated with a vessel inscription, but the images do not establish a chronological path or decide among the proposed analyses involving 斤, 辛, 木, or 𣓀.
